thread:
incident-bot: Pager: METERS_EMIT_DELAY detected in prod for service=billing-emitter (backlog > 12m, emit rate drop). Auto-escalation to oncall. link: https://redwood.ops/alerts/3387654321 :rotating_light:
Dylan (oncall): acked — jumping in. checking emitter consumer groups and Kinesis/queue lag.
Marta: thx. first quick check — are overage flags spiking? customers seeing alerts?
Billing-Eng: seeing a spike in overage flags around 2026-03-15T10:02Z. Snapshot: ~420 flags in a 5m window vs ~12 baseline.
Anya: looks like token counts for a subset of customers dropped to zero then resumed — suspected "emit gap". can we confirm emitter -> aggregator heartbeats?
Dylan (oncall): running quick consumer lag query now: ```sql
-- consumer lag by shard
SELECT shard_id, max(timestamp) as last_processed, max(sequence) as seq
FROM billing_emitter.consumer_offsets
WHERE env = 'prod'
GROUP BY shard_id;
```
Kevin: logs show repeated consumer reconnects from 10:01:31 -> 10:03:02 with ERROR: `kcl.CheckpointTimeout` on node node-8. sample: ```
2026-03-15T10:01:45Z node-8 ERR kcl: checkpoint timeout after 30s, restarting
2026-03-15T10:02:12Z node-8 WARN backpressure: inflight messages 1200
```
Dylan (oncall): that aligns — consumer thrash led to ~90s pause, then backpressure cleared and consumers rejoined, but some windows missed.
Billing-Eng: consequence: partial windows emitted as zero count -> billing pipeline flagged potential undercounts and client-side overage detection flipped to conservative mode, causing overage notifications.
Marta: customers already got emails? Any customer-facing impact logs?
Billing-Eng: a handful of notification emails (internal logs) triggered; we have not pushed outbound to external customer emails yet — ops controls blocked autosend, but internal monitoring shows the alerts queued.
Anya: mitigation proposal: 1) pause automated overage alerts, 2) enable emit-fallback aggregator (reads raw events directly, tolerant to duplicates), 3) kick off backfill for 10:00-10:05 window.
Dylan (oncall): +1. I'll pause alerts now. Command: `curl -XPOST https://redwood.api/ops/flags/pause -d '{"flag":"billing.overage.autosend","reason":"emit-gap-3387654321"}'`
SRE Lead: please also add temporary rate-limiting for emit backlog retries to avoid stampeding. Set `max_retries=3` on emitter client config.
Kevin: applied retry cap to emitter config (rolling restart node-8) — rolling restart initiated: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/billing-emitter -n prod` (node-8 will be restarted first).
Dylan (oncall): paused overage autosend :heavy_check_mark:. Enabling fallback aggregator in read-only mode to validate counts before switching.
Marta: running a quick recon to estimate the delta. Query to compare emitted tokens vs raw ingest: ```sql
WITH emitted AS (
  SELECT customer_id, sum(tokens) as emitted_tokens
  FROM billing.emitter_windowed
  WHERE window_start >= '2026-03-15T10:00:00Z' and window_end <= '2026-03-15T10:10:00Z'
  GROUP BY customer_id
), raw AS (
  SELECT customer_id, sum(tokens) as raw_tokens
  FROM billing.raw_events
  WHERE ts >= '2026-03-15T09:59:30Z' and ts <= '2026-03-15T10:10:30Z'
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT r.customer_id, r.raw_tokens, coalesce(e.emitted_tokens, 0) as emitted_tokens, r.raw_tokens - coalesce(e.emitted_tokens,0) as gap
FROM raw r
LEFT JOIN emitted e USING (customer_id)
ORDER BY gap DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
Anya: preliminary results: ~18 customers with gap > 10k tokens; largest gap is 1.2M tokens for cust_382.
Billing-Eng: starting backfill job for 10:00-10:06 window. Backfill will write to reconciliation topic and mark windows as reconciled once verified. Job id: bf-3387654321-1.
Dylan (oncall): FYI I've posted a short note to #customer-success to hold any outbound escalation for affected accounts and to prepare a post-incident summary if we need to notify.
SRE Lead: timeline/next steps: (1) complete backfill and reconciliation (target 20m), (2) confirm no additional consumer thrash after restart (monitoring for 10m), (3) re-enable autosend after manual confirmation. If gap > 100k tokens for any customer, customer success to draft targeted message.
Marta: can someone paste the backfill status here when done? I'll validate counts and then we can flip over fallback aggregator to golden if reconciled.
Kevin: backfill started -> bf-3387654321-1 status: RUNNING, reading 2.4M raw events, writing 420k reconciled records. ETA ~12m.
Anya: quick note — we should open a root cause ticket: probable cause = consumer checkpoint timeouts under transient load + insufficient backpressure controls. I'll create ticket INFRA-9156.
Dylan (oncall): thanks team. I'll stay on until reconciliation completes. marking this thread for follow-up in incidents postmortems. :loudspeaker: 
incident-bot: Alert auto-clear scheduled once backfill job reports SUCCESS and consumer lag < 30s for 10m.
Marta: confirmed recon results — gaps reconciled for top 20 customers, largest residual gap now 4,200 tokens for cust_382 (acceptable threshold). Re-enabling autosend after 1 round of manual checks.
Dylan (oncall): autosend re-enabled :white_check_mark:. Closing the active pager. Filing follow-up: postmortem + remediation (retry logic, circuit-breaker for emitter, better alerting to separate emit delays from true low usage).
